---
title: "Linear Algebra for Political Scientists"
author: "Diana Kazarian"
date: "September 2026"
date-format: "MMMM YYYY"

A session on the linear algebra that political science methods lean on: vectors and matrices, the operations regression is built from, and how to read them when they appear in a paper or a textbook.

The full notes are published as their own site, **LAPS**, at [dianakazarian.github.io/laps](https://dianakazarian.github.io/laps/). They are embedded below; open the link for the full-width version.
